item.title: Understanding Closures & Scope
item.description: If you’ve ever prepped for a front-end interview, you already know the dreaded question: “Can you explain what a closure is?" :v For the longest time, textbook definitions made my head spin. “A closure is the combination of a function bundled together with references to its surrounding lexical state." …Yeah, thanks for clearing that up! Wkwk… Let’s strip away the academic jargon and look at what actually happens. The Backpack Analogy Think of a function in JavaScript like a traveler going on a road trip.
